value.rationale: The two equilateral base distances 2 and 3 are the only arbitrarily large equilateral parameter families of this natural non-free homogeneous metric structure. Their exact two-type spectra exhibit genuinely distinct limiting channel laws and a sharp strict all-size stochastic comparison, giving structural information absent from merely counting admissible triangles or unary types. This is a motivated complete classification of a finite-base invariant, not an arbitrary case split.
